column1: # Partition table — 4MB flash with dual OTA + SPIFFS
# OTA requires two app partitions (ota_0 + ota_1) so firmware can be
# written to the inactive slot while running from the active slot.
#   otadata     8 KB   — active OTA slot tracking
# app partitions grown from 1312 KB to 1536 KB to accommodate NimBLE + WiFi.
# SPIFFS reduced from 1216 KB to 832 KB — config JSON is <10 KB total.
